title: How Much Fiber in Walnuts? 1.9g per Ounce
description: Walnuts: about 1.9 g of fiber per 1 oz (7% DV), from USDA FoodData Central. Portion table, comparisons, free calculator.
h1: How much fiber is in walnuts?

answer.note: USDA FoodData Central, Nuts, walnuts, english

intro: Walnuts rank #5 of 7 nuts, seeds, and treats on this site for fiber per serving. Every figure below is scaled from USDA FoodData Central, the same data the calculator uses.

dataTable.caption: Fiber in walnuts by portion
dataTable.note: Fiber and calories are scaled from USDA FoodData Central per-100 g values (rows listed under Sources). % Daily Value uses the 28 g reference on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels. Brands, ripeness, and cooking change real values.

sections.heading: How much fiber is in walnuts?
paragraphs: USDA FoodData Central lists nuts, walnuts, english at 6.7 g of fiber per 100 g. One serving (1 oz (about 14 halves); 28.4 g) therefore has about 1.9 g of fiber and 185 calories. That is 7% of the 28 g Daily Value on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels, or 8% of a 25 g day and 5% of a 38 g day.
Walnuts are better known for their omega-3 fat (ALA) than their fiber. Per ounce, they have about half the fiber of almonds, but they are a useful add-on to oatmeal, salads, and baked goods.

sections.heading: Walnuts in context
paragraphs: At roughly 185 calories per ounce, walnuts are one of the more calorie-dense nuts, so their fiber per calorie is lower than almonds or pistachios.
Toasting briefly brings out flavor without changing fiber.

sections.heading: How walnuts compare with other nuts, seeds, and treats
paragraphs: Of the 7 nuts, seeds, and treats on this site, walnuts rank #5 for fiber per typical serving and #6 for fiber per calorie. That works out to 1 g of fiber per 100 calories. Walnuts are calorie-dense, so the portion matters more than the fiber per gram.

Close neighbors by serving: [pumpkin seeds](/fiber-in-pumpkin-seeds) at 1.7 g (1 oz hulled kernels (pepitas)); [peanut butter](/fiber-in-peanut-butter) at 1.6 g (2 tbsp); [flaxseed](/fiber-in-flaxseed) at 2.8 g (1 tbsp, whole). Across all 50 foods in the [fiber-in-foods table](/fiber-in-foods), walnuts are #49 for fiber per calorie.

sections.heading: Adding walnuts to your day
paragraphs: Two tablespoons of chopped walnuts on oatmeal with berries adds crunch, ALA, and a little fiber.

Example: 1 oz walnuts, 1 cup oatmeal, 1/2 cup blueberries. Using the same USDA values as the calculator, that comes to about 7.7 g of fiber, with 1.9 g from the walnuts. Adjust the amounts in the calculator to match your plate.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in 100 g of walnuts?
faqs.a: 6.7 g, according to USDA FoodData Central (Nuts, walnuts, english). That is the figure every portion on this page is scaled from.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in walnuts (1/4 cup chopped)?
faqs.a: About 2 g, for 29.3 g. Weigh your portion or edit grams in the calculator for a closer estimate.
Almonds have about twice as much per ounce: about 3.5 g (1 oz (about 23 almonds)).
